blocks.title: ForeverRPC
blocks.tagline: Discord Rich Presence for TrackMania Nations and United Forever, as a ModLoader mod.

items.title: Rich Presence
items.text: Shows what you play on Discord: map, environment, server and player count.

items.title: Own texts
items.text: A ForeverRPC.toml next to TmForever.exe sets the message for each game state.

items.title: Rust
items.text: Written in Rust and built as a 32-bit DLL.

blocks.title: Config
blocks.markdown: The TOML file supports placeholders such as the server name, nickname, map name, environment name, player count, account type (Nations or United) and online mode name.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: ForeverRPC is made by AroPix for the ModLoader of Tomashu.
